description: This file defines a foreground service for an Android application that manages the connection status of an OpenClaw node, updates notifications, and handles lifecycle events including starting and stopping the service.

classes.name: NodeForegroundService
classes.description: An Android foreground service that manages the connection status of an OpenClaw node, updates notifications accordingly, and handles lifecycle events such as start, stop, and destroy.

classes.name: Quint
classes.description: A private data class to hold five related status values used for updating notifications.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes notification channel and starts foreground notification with initial status. Launches a coroutine that updates the notification based on runtime status.

methods.name: onStartCommand
methods.description: Handles incoming commands; stops service if ACTION_STOP is received.

methods.name: onDestroy
methods.description: Cancels ongoing coroutines and cleans up resources.

methods.name: onBind
methods.description: Returns null as binding is not used.

methods.name: ensureChannel
methods.description: Creates a notification channel if it doesn't already exist.

methods.name: buildNotification
methods.description: Builds the notification displayed in the foreground, with actions for interacting with the service.

methods.name: updateNotification
methods.description: Updates the ongoing notification with new content.

methods.name: startForegroundWithTypes
methods.description: Starts the service in the foreground with a notification, or updates it if already started.
